title: Graham Hancock's lost Ice Age civilization

tellings.quote: Graham thinks this is these were built by um ancient peoples the Atlanteanss or whoever

plain: Michael Shermer, a well-known skeptic, describes on Jesse Michels's podcast the idea of the writer Graham Hancock, set out in books like "Fingerprints of the Gods". According to Shermer, Hancock thinks very old sites such as Göbekli Tepe, an ancient stone site in Turkey, were built by a lost advanced people from before the end of the Ice Age, "the Atlanteans or whoever." If true, human history would be much older and stranger than the textbooks say.
